import re

app = Flask(__name__)

    # Remove HTML comments and any suspicious patterns
    sanitized_input = re.sub(r'<!--.*?-->', '', user_input)
    # Further sanitization logic can be added here

## Explanation

The vulnerability was caused by the AI model processing unsanitized user input, allowing indirect prompt injections. The fix involves implementing an input sanitization function that removes HTML comments and other suspicious patterns from the user input before processing it with the AI model. This prevents malicious instructions from being executed.
